card.fact_statement: Norina Tangaro-Casingal was appointed as a COMELEC commissioner ahead of the 2025 Philippine general election.
card.source_span: President Marcos appointed Norina Tangaro-Casingal, erstwhile director of the Commission on Elections law department as commissioner on February 10, 2025

target_qa_variants.question: 在2025年菲律宾大选前，谁被任命为选举委员会（COMELEC）委员？
target_qa_variants.source_span: President Marcos appointed Norina Tangaro-Casingal, erstwhile director of the Commission on Elections law department as commissioner on February 10, 2025
target_qa_variants.translation_note: COMELEC is translated as 选举委员会. The person's name is kept in English as there is no widely established Chinese translation.

backtranslation_en.question: Before the 2025 Philippine general election, who was appointed as a commissioner of the Commission on Elections (COMELEC)?

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The target language QA accurately translates the source question and preserves the same fact and expected answer.
